text: Silver Mage

In the annals of time, an ancient order of sages known as the
Silver Mages emerges, a venerable lineage of scholars and
mystics who sought to bridge the gap between mortals and
the divine. Venerating the gods with unyielding reverence,
they devoted themselves to unraveling the sacred mysteries
that lie beyond the veil of mortal understanding. From the
hallowed halls of their sanctuaries, these theologians delve
deep into the arcane tapestry of religious knowledge,
becoming masters of divine lore.
Theology Savant

Beginning at 2nd level, you gain proficiency with Intelligence
(religion) ability checks.
Additionally, you can use magic items and spell scrolls
ignoring class prerequisites if the prerequisite is to have
levels in the cleric class
Divine Space

Also at 2nd level, you gain the ability to create a Divine Space,
a small pocket dimension that reflects your connection to the
divine. As an action, you can create an extradimensional
space that lasts for 1 hour times your Wizard level. The door
to the space appears in an unoccupied space of your choosing
within 30 feet of you.
This space is a 10-foot cube and initially contains only bare
essentials, such as a simple altar, candles, and some religious
symbols. You can dismiss the Divine Space as a bonus action.
While in your Divine Space, you have advantage on
concentration saving throws.

This space expands as you grow, the Divine Space expands in
increments of 5 feet in all directions times your Wizard level.
Sanctuary of the Devotee

At 6th level, you gain a deeper control over your Divine
Space. You can now add additional features to your Divine
Space when you summon it choosing from one of the
following options:

Healing Font. A small pool of water with healing
properties appears. Once per long rest, you or any
creature within the Divine Space can use a bonus action
to drink from the font and regain hit points equal to your
wizard level.
Knowledge Archive. A bookshelf filled with divine and
theological tomes appears. Over the course of 10 minutes,
you study these books and gain proficiency in one skill or
language of your choice. This benefit lasts until you finish
your next long rest.
Nature's Embrace. The Divine Space transforms into a
tranquil glade filled with natural wonders. You and
friendly creatures within the Divine Space gain the
benefits of the speak with animals spell, and you have
advantage on Wisdom (Animal Handling) checks.
Hall of Judgment. The Divine Space shifts into a solemn
courtroom, symbolizing your role as an arbiter of divine
justice. You gain the ability to cast the zone of truth spell
without expending a spell slot, and you have advantage on
Wisdom (Insight) checks.

Divine Hegemon

Bane's Malevolence. Hostile creatures within 10 feet of
you must make a Charisma saving throw against your
spell save DC. On a failed save, they are affected by the
bane spell for 1 minute. A creature affected by this feature
can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns,
ending the effect on a success.
Blessing of Radiance. Friendly creatures within 10 feet
of you gain the benefits of the bless spell. Once per turn, a
creature affected by this feature can add a d4 to one attack
roll or saving throw before the next turn ends.

You can use this feature once and regain all uses upon
finishing a long rest. Additionally, while within your Divine
Space hostile creatures always act as if under the bane spell
and all friendly creatures act as if under the bless spell.
Temple to the Silver Mage

You are always aware of all creatures within your Divine
Space.
You can replicate any object or creature within your Divine
space. These replications are facsimiles of the originals
unable to deal damage, leave the Divine Space, or have
any knowledge or magic that you yourself do not have.
While you are within your Divine Space you hear any
prayers deliberately addressed to you from creatures as if
they had used the sending spell.
